principle: a versioned adapter / contract layer between P2-C (feature set p2c-fs 1.0.0, label set p2c-ls 1.0.0, frozen) and P2-X (v1 legs, frozen; v2 contract set). No frozen historical output is rewritten: P2-C rows keep their bytes and row ids, P2-X legs keep their estimate ids. The adapter adds an execution request per P2-C row and a joined record per estimate.

canonical_identity.calendar: crypto-24x7-utc (timezone UTC, sessions continuous, day boundary 00:00:00Z = the collector seal unit)

join_key_rule: P2-C row (symbol, decision_time_ms) -> instrument_id = binance_spot_instrument(symbol).instrument_id; exactly one P2-C row per key and exactly one P2-X estimate per (key, scenario, side); anything else is AMBIGUOUS and must be 0

missing_fields_resolution.gap: P2-C rows carry symbol only, no canonical instrument_id
missing_fields_resolution.resolution: derived deterministically by the adapter via p2_research.instrument.binance_spot_instrument(symbol) (crypto Binance spot only; any other market refused); the execution request carries the full identity and instrument_id_derivation. The frozen P2-C feature set is NOT changed; storing instrument_id per row is deferred to a future feature-set version

missing_fields_resolution.gap: P2-X estimates carry no reference to the P2-C dataset / row
missing_fields_resolution.resolution: p2c_row_ref = {dataset_logical_hash, feature_set {id, version, registry_sha256}, row_id} on every execution request, echoed on every joined record (and on scenario_set_result); the v1 leg record is not modified

missing_fields_resolution.gap: dataset identity names differ (P2-X market_data.dataset_sha256 vs P2-C source.dataset_json_sha256; per-day seal SHAs)
missing_fields_resolution.resolution: mapping P2-X market_data.dataset_sha256 == P2-C source.dataset_json_sha256, dataset_id equal, every P2-X day a P2-C day with an EQUAL seal_sha256; otherwise the join is refused (JOIN_IDENTITY_MISMATCH). The join manifest records the P2-C manifest logical hash and the features-file SHA

missing_fields_resolution.gap: P2-X quantities have no per-field knowledge time
missing_fields_resolution.resolution: result_schema_v2.json leg_field_knowledge_time (STATIC / DECISION / EXECUTION / UNAVAILABLE_BY_DESIGN / REFERENCE for every leg field, nested fields individually); the joined record splits decision_side (STATIC + DECISION) and label_side (EXECUTION + UNAVAILABLE_BY_DESIGN) and states knowledge_time_ms for both sides; an unmapped field refuses the join

missing_fields_resolution.gap: P2-X tier = record tier at execution time; P2-C tier = universe-epoch tier known at T
missing_fields_resolution.resolution: the request carries decision_epoch_tier (= the P2-C row tier, epoch known at T); the joined record renames the leg tier to label_side.execution_record_tier. Any feature-side or stratification use takes decision_epoch_tier only

missing_fields_resolution.gap: P2-X exit leg and P2-C exe.net_ret_h are different exit definitions
missing_fields_resolution.resolution: every request names its exit_definition; label families are declared distinct (see exit_definitions); a trial declares exactly one family; mixing families in one trial is refused unless a mapping is predeclared in the trial specification

p2x_entry_leg.definition: BUY leg: touch (ask) of the book at T + scenario latency, adjusted by the scenario slippage; label family x1.*

p2x_exit_leg.definition: SELL leg at a separately requested exit decision time T_exit: touch (bid) at T_exit + scenario latency, adjusted by the scenario slippage (depth walk for BASE / STRESS); label family x1.*

p2c_exe_label.definition: p2c-ls 1.0.0 exe.net_ret_h: ln(bid of the first book in (T+h, T+h+60 s] / entry ask of the first book in (T, T+60 s]) - 2 x 10 bps; top of book only, no latency model, no depth; label family exe.*

exit_definitions.rule: x1.* and exe.* are different labels; neither is a substitute for the other

pit_rule: decision-side fields are available at or before T (P2-X PIT view; P2-C feature_available_at <= T); label-side fields are known only at T + latency (or later) and never enter a feature. W3 decision or execution times are refused (unmatched with reason), never read

records.execution_request: tsb.p2x.execution_request v1: request_id, join_contract, contract_set_sha256, instrument (+ derivation), decision_time_ms, decision_epoch_tier, universe_id, p2c_row_ref, scenario, direction, side, leg, order_notional, exit_definition
records.joined_execution: tsb.p2x.joined_execution v1: joined_id, join_key, request_id, estimate_id, p2c_row_ref, decision_epoch_tier, exit_definition, knowledge_time_ms, decision_side, label_side

adapter: p2_research.execution.join (stdlib; reads only the P2-C manifest and the key / PIT columns of features.jsonl.gz plus two decision-time quality values for a same-state consistency check; never opens labels.jsonl.gz)
